class.name: NNSTBranchNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for State Tree nodes that can hold active child states ([NNSTRoot] and [NNSTTickedNodes]).
class.description: Input events are only delivered to active states. A script on an active state receives them through [method on_input], [method on_unhandled_input] and [method on_unhandled_key_input], or through the engine input virtuals it overrides itself. States share their data through the blackboard of the nearest root of any Noodle Nodes system, inherited from [NoodleNodes]. Use [method NoodleNodes.get_blackboard], [method NoodleNodes.set_blackboard], [method NoodleNodes.has_blackboard], [method NoodleNodes.erase_blackboard] and [method NoodleNodes.get_blackboard_resource] for it, and [method NoodleNodes.get_actor] for the resolved actor.

method.name: get_is_active
method.description: Returns if the state is currently active. This is set to [code]true[/code] when the state is entered and [code]false[/code] when exited.

method.name: on_input
method.description: See [method Node._input]. Input processing for this callback is enabled automatically while this state is active (see [method get_is_active]) and the script implements this method.

method.name: on_unhandled_input
method.description: See [method Node._unhandled_input]. Unhandled input processing for this callback is enabled automatically while this state is active (see [method get_is_active]) and the script implements this method.

method.name: on_unhandled_key_input
method.description: See [method Node._unhandled_key_input]. Unhandled key input processing for this callback is enabled automatically while this state is active (see [method get_is_active]) and the script implements this method.

method.name: send_event
method.description: Sends an event to the chart. Events are queued on the [NNSTRoot] and processed one at a time in FIFO order, so calling this from a callback (for example [method NNSTTickedNodes.on_enter_state], [method NNSTTickedNodes.on_exit_state] or a guard) does not process the event recursively. The event is handled after the transition that is running and all of its callbacks have completed, whether that transition came from an event or from a direct [method NNSTTickedNodes.transition_to] call. The event is delivered to the innermost active state first and bubbles up to its ancestors until a state consumes it. A compound state forwards the event to its active child first and only handles it when that child did not. A parallel state forwards the event to every active region. The root is the last state to see the event, so transitions attached directly to the root are only tried when no active child consumed it. Every transition with a matching event name is tried in child order; a transition whose guard fails does not consume the event, so the remaining transitions and the parent states still receive it. Emits [signal NNSTRoot.event_received] on the root and [signal NNSTTickedNodes.event_received] on every state the event is delivered to. A root-level transition whose target is the currently active root child does nothing. A processing pass that applies more than 100 transitions is treated as an infinite loop: an error is printed, the pending queue is discarded, the chart is marked invalid and later events are ignored.

members.member: How a child state is chosen: [code]OnEnterConditionMethod[/code] ([code]0[/code]) or [code]UtilityScoring[/code] ([code]1[/code]). With [code]OnEnterConditionMethod[/code], each enabled child's [method NNSTTickedNodes.on_enter_condition] is called in order and the first one returning [code]true[/code] is selected. With [code]UtilityScoring[/code], each enabled child is scored from its child [NNConsiderations] nodes (aggregated using [member NNSTTickedNodes.evaluation_method]) and the highest-scoring state is chosen. [b]Note:[/b] This setting has no effect on [NNSTParallel], which always evaluates all enabled child states in order with [method NNSTTickedNodes.on_enter_condition].
